purpose: The findings that are true of the batch rather than of one family, measured across all of it at once so a shared defect is not mistaken for a per-form one.

provenanceConformance.question: Does each committed sidecar carry the 20 fields plus page count that the shared PDF contract requires?
provenanceConformance.whyThisWasNeverCaught: scripts/verify-rcap-shared-pdf-contract.mjs proves the P-block against a sidecar it synthesizes from a canary. It never opens a committed one, so the contract can pass while no artifact on disk satisfies it.
provenanceConformance.whyNot: rcap-platform-ready.mjs checks the approval, the artifact hashes, the classification and the finalized-artifact audit. It does not read the sidecar's field set. So this is a divergence between the contract the platform states and the gate the platform enforces, not a gate failure.

creationDateDrift.question: Which artifacts were produced before carryDates() started taking /CreationDate from the source?
creationDateDrift.note: A contact sheet is composed fresh and has no source date to carry, so the deterministic stamp is correct there and is not counted as drift.

approvalChannel.question: Can an approval of this family be recorded anywhere the shared gate will read?
approvalChannel.consequence: A family that cannot record an approval cannot reach platform_ready, however clean its review. This blocks more of the batch than every form-level finding combined.
